**What was built**

- `ClickStatsAggregator` (analytics.aggregation): one `@Transactional` unit of work per event. It claims the idempotency key in `processed_click_event` via the existing `ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING` insert, returns `DUPLICATE` without touching aggregates when the key exists, otherwise upserts `click_stats` (total, `GREATEST` on `last_clicked_at`, `updated_at`) and the `click_stats_daily` row for the UTC day of `occurred_at`. Marker and aggregates commit or roll back together.
- `ClickEventConsumer` (analytics.consumer): `@KafkaListener` on `url.clicked` (group `click-stats-aggregator`, toggleable via `analytics.consumer.auto-startup`, default on). Parses the `idempotency-key` header and the JSON contract fields into the existing `ClickEventMessage`, then runs the aggregator through the shared `RetryExecutor` (bounded attempts, backoff + jitter, per-attempt timeout). Terminal outcomes: `APPLIED`, `DUPLICATE`, `REJECTED` (malformed, no retry), `EXHAUSTED` (logged with cause class/message, metered, acknowledged so there is no infinite redelivery).
- `ConsumerMetrics`: applied / duplicate / rejected / exhausted counters, mirroring `OutboxMetrics`.
- Logs carry only key, short code, topic coordinates and exception class/message; `hashed_ip` and referrer are never logged (asserted in tests). No raw IP touches these classes.

**Tests**

| Test | Covers |
|---|---|
| `ClickStatsAggregatorTest` (7) | claim-then-upsert order, duplicate no-op, UTC midnight bucketing incl. non-UTC source offset, rollback propagation, `@Transactional`, no hashed IP in logs |
| `ClickStatsAggregatorIT` (5, real Postgres) | single event, duplicate no-op (totals, last click, daily, marker count), out-of-order `last_clicked_at`, midnight split, marker rollback on failure |
| `ClickEventConsumerTest` (11) | deserialisation, null referrer, duplicate, transient retry with backoff, retry exhaustion terminal state, per-attempt timeout, 5 malformed shapes rejected without retry, listener annotation, log privacy |
| `ConsumerMetricsTest` (1) | counters |
